notes:
Manafall 0.1.31 — Windows client

Online and host
- Public server list can show your game across networks when the game port answers.
- Listen host adds Windows Firewall allows for the game port, listing, and LAN beacon.
- Joining players get terrain under their feet first so the ground loads with them.
- Join toasts, Tab roster gamertags, hold-key who’s online.
- Host world save keeps gear, buildings, and chests (name the world from Host when the panel is wired).

Admin
- /admin tools, /players, /kick and /ban with reason.

Stealth and combat
- Sneak checks work on bandits, skeletons, zombies, wildlife, and other hunters.
- Soft red arc on the screen rim shows which way a hit came from.

Settings and desktop
- Settings dropdowns open and pick again.
- Put On Desktop\Manafall.exe — move that starter to your Desktop; no shortcut needed.

Performance
- Forest trees past the near ring use impostors; shorter trunk shadows; thinner forest grass.

Patcher
- Keeps a partial download; only installs a full matching client zip.

Auto-update downloads three parts. Leave ~4 GB free on your Windows drive.
